note: The 11 no_catalog rows east of the Mississippi (MI 3, OH 2, GA, KY, NC, NH, PA, WI). None of these has a recreation.gov campground page (all are POI records), so the agency's own site and reviews are the only sources. 1 added, 10 excluded. Two are duplicates of rows already judged under other facility ids.

added.name: Kokosing Lake Campground (Fredericktown)
added.caveat: run by the Fredericktown Recreation District on a Corps lake, so local rather than federal; phone/in-person reservations only; RIDB pin is at the dam outlet 1 km from the campground

excluded.name: Cottonwood Patch Campground
excluded.why: same campground as facility 10303081, excluded 2026-09-22 as a horse camp (ridb_gap_ga_decisions.json)

excluded.name: Little Bass Lake Campsites
excluded.why: already in the database as 13210 (added from facility 273349), 0.1 km away

excluded.name: Hovey Lake Campsites (Hiawatha NF)
excluded.why: 4 small sites; reviewers: trailers over 22 ft scrape branches or can't back in, access road narrow with tight turns

excluded.name: Langford Lake Boat Launch (Ottawa NF)
excluded.why: a boat launch with primitive camping; no source gives a site count, site size or whether an RV fits

excluded.name: Boone Fork Campground
excluded.why: 'Campers must hike in to the developed areas'; not maintained

excluded.name: Wild River Campground (White Mountain NF)
excluded.why: FS: closed due to storm damage to Wild River Road; no source gives a site length. Recheck when it reopens

excluded.name: North Twin Lake Recreation Area
excluded.why: campground closed since 2019, the boat landing alone kept open

excluded.name: Woodcock Creek Lake Park & Campground
excluded.why: RIDB (Woodcock Lake Park 10132301): 'There are currently no camping opportunities at Woodcock Lake Park'; the Corps areas are day use only

excluded.name: German Bridge campground (Dewey Lake)
excluded.why: only aggregator prose describes it (snoflo-style '44 sites, RVs allowed'); the Corps' Dewey Lake page could not be read and nothing authoritative confirms an operating RV campground

excluded.name: Mohawk Dam Campground
excluded.why: aggregators claim 31 electric sites below the dam, but the Corps pages could not be read, one summary of them says a dry dam with no recreation, and no dated firsthand review exists

recheck.why: Wild River (NH) reopens after the road repair; German Bridge and Mohawk Dam need the Corps' own pages read (blocked from this machine) or a dated firsthand report.
